# humanizer (vendored)

`SKILL.md` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from
[blader/humanizer](https://github.com/blader/humanizer), commit
`9862685f575c65a8247f90369951df1b3416e3d6` (2026-09-06, skill version 3.0.0).
MIT licensed; the licence travels with it.

`humanizer.py` reads `SKILL.md` as the system prompt for Study's Humanizer and adds
Vesta's own output instructions after it. To update, copy a newer `SKILL.md` over this
one and record the new commit here. Nothing else needs to change unless the skill's
"What to return" section is restructured.
